origin.description: index returns the index of a zoo series. A plain matrix or vector uses 1 through NROW. A series with tsp uses seq(start, end, by = 1/frequency).

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: An object. A zoo series stores observations separately from its index.

origin.details: index returns the index of a zoo series. A plain matrix or vector uses 1 through NROW. A series with tsp uses seq(start, end, by = 1/frequency).
origin.example:
x <- zoo(c(3, 1), c(5, 8))
cat(paste(index(x), collapse = " "), "\n", sep = "")

translation.example:
import numpy as np
from zoo.series import Zoo
from zoo.index import index
x = Zoo(np.array([3.0, 1.0]), [5, 8])
print(" ".join(str(int(v)) for v in index(x)))
